ai_review.review: The Schoeps‑based audience recording is praised for its clarity, depth and ability to convey the hall’s ambiance, even if it sounds a touch narrow. Reviewers note it outperforms typical board mixes and captures an enriching night of music, though no specific song or performance details are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted the superior sound quality; lack of musical detail keeps the overall rating solid but not exceptional.
